title: AI Voice Mock Interview Simulator & Portal
desc: An interactive, serverless AI voice simulator developed for intensive mock interview training. Candidate resumes are parsed directly in the browser via PDF.js, triggering a real-time voice activity Hindi/English conversation loop (Web Audio/Speech APIs) featuring noise calibration and interruption-handling to model real-world high-pressure interviews.
outcome: Operates as a high-fidelity training sandbox; scales at ~$0.05 API cost per interview simulation, logging comprehensive performance feedback and scoring metrics to a central Sheets database.
product_problem: Candidates lack realistic, adaptive, real-time sandboxes to practice verbal delivery under pressure.
product_users: 108+ team members and corporate candidates.
product_sol: Interactive, voice-first mock interview training portal using Web Audio and generative AI.
product_dec: Used browser-side PDF.js parsing to keep user data private and minimize server compute costs, combined with Speech API VAD calibration.
product_out: Lowered costs to ~$0.05 per interview, capturing 100% of feedback markers.

title: AI-Powered Call QA Analysis System
desc: An automated evaluation engine processing over 1,200 recordings daily (800 minutes of voice data) from 12 decentralized telecalling units. Analyzes audio transcripts to provide highly structured feedback on customer tone, script alignment, purchase intent, and next-action pipelines.
outcome: Eliminated manual QA sampling, driving 100% evaluation coverage and automated feedback loops for team leads.
product_problem: Manual QA audits covered <2% of daily recordings, leaving agent execution errors undetected.
product_users: 12 decentralized telecalling units, auditing 1,200 daily records.
product_sol: Speech-to-text transcript processing engine analyzing objections, script alignment, and tone.
product_dec: Restructured pipeline with a rate-limited task queuing matrix to handle API thresholds for 800 daily audio minutes.
product_out: Achieved 100% evaluation coverage, saving 360 hours of manual evaluation monthly.

title: B2B Order Booking Workspace
desc: A serverless, mobile-optimized B2B order portal designed to replace scattered communication channels. Features client-side state caching, custom token authentication, catalog search engines, and real-time client-side PDF invoicing.
outcome: Slashed recurring booking loops by >60% while running at absolute zero operating cost via serverless hosting.
product_problem: Scattered order collections via text/emails caused invoice errors and delayed booking (avg. 8 mins/order).
product_users: Field sales agents and distributor reps.
product_sol: Serverless web workspace with Edge caching, custom SKU filtering, and instant PDF invoice compilation.
product_dec: Bypassed heavy database costs by building secure client-side caching linked to serverless Apps Script endpoints.
product_out: Reduced booking time from 8 minutes to 45 seconds, with 100% ordering accuracy.

title: Predictive Inventory & PO Optimizer
desc: A strategic stock governance dashboard tracking absolute inventories, batch histories, safety margins, and active backlogs. Integrates a predictive reordering engine driven by safety thresholds and rolling averages, combined with complete vendor PO lifecycle tracking.
outcome: Reduced chronic shortages from 17 to 2, optimizing stock rotation and driving 20% sales expansion.
product_problem: Frequent stockouts and overstocking tied up capital and limited regional sales velocity.
product_users: Supply chain managers and procurement officers.
product_sol: Analytics dashboard tracking batch history and calculating reorder recommendations.
product_dec: Implemented safety stock formulations based on supplier lead-time variance rather than simple static caps.
product_out: Reduced shortages from 17 to 2, accelerating stock rotation and enabling a 20% sales expansion.

title: Looker Studio Real-Time Refresher
desc: A custom Chrome extension engineered to bypass the native 15-minute Looker Studio data caching limits. Injects background event runners to trigger real-time, non-invasive dashboard database queries while completely preserving user-selected filters, pivots, and screen scroll coordinates.
outcome: Enabled real-time, live operational telemetry monitoring for senior executives during key cycles.
product_problem: Native 15-minute caching limits prevented executive monitoring of live sales operations.
product_users: Senior executives and operations controllers.
product_sol: Chrome extension injecting background scripts to force data refreshes without losing filter states.
product_dec: Chose DOM event injection over full page reloading to prevent disruption to user viewports and active scroll ranges.
product_out: Reduced telemetry lag from 15 minutes to instantaneous, real-time live monitoring.

title: OmniReader — Spatial Reader Workspace
desc: A premium, ultra-fast client-side document reading environment processing EPUB, PDF, and DOCX extensions. Built with local storage state management, dynamic semantic outlines, text-to-speech rendering, full-text instant index indexing, and adaptive layout themes.
outcome: Zero server-load cost architecture keeping reading sessions fully private and localized inside client sandboxes.
product_problem: Standard document readers require heavy servers for parsing, creating privacy concerns and server overhead.
product_users: Readers processing EPUB, PDF, and DOCX files.
product_sol: Fully client-side reader with full-text search, outline indexing, and TTS rendering.
product_dec: Opted for client-side file reading, storing reading configurations in IndexedDB to protect data privacy.
product_out: Reduced server operating costs to $0.00 while maintaining private, localized reading sandboxes.

title: End-to-End Sales Control System
desc: An operations tracking system managing order pipelines from entry to transit, delivery verification, and exception logging. Includes trigger alerts and structured task assignments for dispatch supervisors.
outcome: Decreased order-to-dispatch transit lag by 30% and enhanced final delivery success metrics by 15%.
product_problem: Poor tracking of order dispatch pipelines led to delivery delays and high transit exception rates.
product_users: Dispatch supervisors and delivery controllers.
product_sol: Transit tracking workspace with exception logs, SLA timers, and automated team assignments.
product_dec: Designed the system with color-coded transit status blocks to prioritize resolving critical exception delays.
product_out: Decreased dispatch lag by 30% and improved delivery success rates by 15%.

title: Task Matrix & Performance Scoring
desc: An enterprise execution matrix linking periodic staff tasks to individual performance logs, structuring a feedback loop from assignment to final scoring evaluation.
outcome: Lifted general SLA compliance and task completion indices by 40% across administrative departments.
product_problem: Lack of structured task tracking caused missed deadlines and subjective performance reviews.
product_users: Administrative managers and department staff.
product_sol: Task accountability matrix linking regular deliverables to objective performance logs.
product_dec: Used a relative score distribution model rather than absolute marks to prevent grading inflation across teams.
product_out: Increased administrative SLA compliance by 40% using automated performance logging.

title: District Monopoly & Control System
desc: A dynamic territory mapping and management database tracking monopoly allocations, local sales performance, warning triggers, and automated contract termination logs.
outcome: Streamlined regional governance and automated warnings for underperforming territory allocations.
product_problem: Overlapping territory allocations caused dealer disputes, diluting brand pricing margins.
product_users: Territory sales managers and legal compliance teams.
product_sol: Dealer mapping database monitoring monopoly boundaries and sales performance thresholds.
product_dec: Implemented automated warnings that fire as soon as regional dealer volumes drop below local targets.
product_out: Resolved overlapping distribution disputes, automating contract compliance checks.

title: Short Product & Restock Trigger
desc: A real-time database capturing unfulfilled client demand during order placement and linking it with active inventory updates to auto-alert sales agents as soon as items return to stock.
outcome: Recovered previously lost repeat orders by instantly pushing availability notifications to regional reps.
product_problem: When items went out of stock, client orders were cancelled and salesmen forgot to re-pitch when items returned.
product_users: Sales agents and inventory controllers.
product_sol: Demand capture database linking unfulfilled sales orders to inventory arrival hooks for automated alerts.
product_dec: Created direct WhatsApp/Email alert triggers for regional reps rather than passive dashboard markers.
product_out: Bypassed order losses by notifying agents the moment items hit the shelves.

title: Lead Quality & De-duplication Engine
desc: A validation pipeline utilizing regular expression validation and dynamic cross-referencing algorithms to clean and de-duplicate contact database sheets before CRM entry.
outcome: Eliminated ~25% database clutter and duplicate lead allocations, preserving CRM record hygiene.
product_problem: Duplicate client data uploads caused salesmen to pitch to the same contacts, creating friction.
product_users: CRM administrators and lead generation leads.
product_sol: Lead cleaning pipeline with regex validation and dynamic cross-reference matching.
product_dec: Implemented fuzzy phone number normalization to catch duplicates using different formats.
product_out: Cleaned contact files before database import, removing 25% duplicate and invalid entries.

title: Vendor Payables Ledger Dashboard
desc: A secure cash outflow dashboard organizing payments, credit timelines, and validation logs, featuring automated alerts on upcoming invoice maturities.
outcome: Optimized working capital visibility and avoided delay penalties across 40+ corporate supply vendors.
product_problem: Delayed invoices led to late penalties and interrupted manufacturer supply channels.
product_users: Accounts payable teams and finance heads.
product_sol: Outflow dashboard tracking credit periods, validation files, and maturity timers.
product_dec: Built a calendar view showing daily cash requirements to prevent sudden working capital locks.
product_out: Avoided late penalties across 40+ vendors, keeping credit channels open.

title: Complaint Management & Escalation Engine
desc: A multi-level trouble ticketing system routing client and operational complaints to corresponding team leads with built-in escalation timers.
outcome: Slashed average complaint resolution cycle times by 48 hours via structured department escalation triggers.
product_problem: Client complaints got stuck in employee email boxes, causing long resolution times.
product_users: Customer support agents and operations heads.
product_sol: Ticketing dashboard routing logs to departments with built-in escalation warnings.
product_dec: Set up warning escalations that alert division heads if a ticket stays open past 24 hours.
product_out: Slashed average complaint resolution time by 48 hours via automated escalations.

title: Unified Inventory, Batch & Collections Ledger
desc: A comprehensive operational dataset model unifying inventory records, production batch lifetimes, and cash collections into a consolidated corporate reporting layer.
outcome: Consolidated three previously isolated data streams into a single source of truth for boardroom reviews.
product_problem: Siloed data in sales, stock, and cash ledgers made it hard to review weekly performance.
product_users: Boardroom executives and finance controllers.
product_sol: Integrated ledger blending stock batches, invoices, and payment data.
product_dec: Chose to merge data at the report layer rather than altering underlying system databases to prevent sync errors.
product_out: Consolidated three isolated systems into a single dashboard for executive meetings.

title: SCOT Predictive Purchase Pattern Dashboard
desc: A behavior-driven predictive dashboard analyzing historical B2B purchase frequencies to calculate and forecast future reorder timelines per client.
outcome: Enabled predictive sales calling across 500+ SKUs by anticipating client restocking cycles.
product_problem: Sales calls were reactive, missing dealer inventory exhaustion moments.
product_users: Sales reps and regional managers.
product_sol: Predictive dashboard tracking customer purchasing histories to estimate future restocking dates.
product_dec: Utilized client-specific demand waves rather than national averages to customize sales calling triggers.
product_out: Enabled predictive sales calling across 500+ SKUs, increasing client repeat buys.

title: Android Call Recording Synchronizer
desc: A custom background mobile script running localized file system hooks on Android devices to safely ingest and sync call audio recordings straight to secure Drive folders.
outcome: Secured 100% data compliance capture rates for the call quality evaluation pipeline across 12 remote agents.
product_problem: Remote agents forgot to upload recording files, breaking the call QA analysis cycle.
product_users: 12 remote telecalling agents.
product_sol: Android background script monitoring directory creations and syncing files to Drive.
product_dec: Faced with mobile OS sleep cycles, designed a deferred check-in process that restarts upload threads.
product_out: Secured 100% call capture compliance, feeding recordings into the AI QA evaluator.

title: Control Sample Lifecycle Monitor
desc: A quality audit logging environment tracing periodic product control samples, cross-referencing batch numbers and expiration schedules.
outcome: Achieved 100% structural alignment with regulatory quarterly pharmaceutical quality audit sheets.
product_problem: Tracking physical control samples in pharmaceutical batches was manual, risking audit failures.
product_users: Quality control officers and warehouse managers.
product_sol: Digital logging environment cross-referencing batch IDs and sample locations.
product_dec: Used automated status flags to highlight expiring control samples before quarterly audit cycles.
product_out: Secured 100% compliance alignment with regulatory quality audit requirements.

title: Dynamic Google Form Prefill System
desc: An automated URL parameter builder that dynamically injects client metadata and context IDs into form links, eliminating duplicate entry needs.
outcome: Eliminated manual entry typos by field operators submitting inventory status sheets.
product_problem: Field agents wasted time re-typing customer IDs and SKU info on mobile inventory sheets.
product_users: Field operators and warehouse staff.
product_sol: URL parameter builder injecting metadata into forms based on dealer selection.
product_dec: Decided to build prefill links client-side to prevent server-side wait states for agents.
product_out: Cut entry times and eliminated manual typos on incoming inventory sheets.

title: Dynamic Sales Incentive & Commission Calculator
desc: An automated commission engine tracking regional sales tiers, growth metrics, and milestone payout ratios for field forces, replacing fragile excel sheets.
outcome: Standardized commission tracking, providing absolute computational accuracy and cutting processing latency.
product_problem: Calculating complex commission tiers on Excel sheets took days, leading to payment disputes.
product_users: HR managers, sales executives, and accounting teams.
product_sol: Apps Script commission engine calculating tiers and payout ratios from sales logs.
product_dec: Used a single source of truth sales table to calculate commissions, resolving mismatches.
product_out: Reduced commission processing times from 4 days to instant, eliminating payroll disputes.

title: Dynamic Freight & Logistical Cost Estimator
desc: A shipping cost calculator evaluating volumetric weights, dimensions, geographical transit zones, and fuel surcharges to generate transport quotes.
outcome: Slashed transport quoting lag times and eliminated shipping invoice discrepancies.
product_problem: Manual freight calculations led to delays in client quotes and shipping invoice discrepancies.
product_users: Logistics coordinators and dispatch planners.
product_sol: Shipping calculator evaluating sizes, weights, and fuel rates to estimate costs.
product_dec: Pre-loaded regional transport tables to speed up offline quotes for field operators.
product_out: Slashed quote times and removed shipping invoice errors.

title: Promotional Input Allocation & Budget Tracker
desc: An allocation dashboard modeling marketing sample distributions, regional promotional expenses, and material allocations against net sales returns.
outcome: Enforced strict budgetary limits on sales promo allocations and boosted material spending efficiency.
product_problem: Field agents distributed marketing samples without limits, causing budget overruns.
product_users: Marketing managers and regional sales managers.
product_sol: Allocation dashboard matching sample distribution against regional sales budgets.
product_dec: Set hard allocation limits that adjust dynamically based on regional sales volumes.
product_out: Enforced limits on promo materials, keeping distribution costs within budget.

title: Party Performance & Client Health Analytics
desc: A comprehensive B2B client analysis system tracking historical purchasing logs, rotation speed, aging accounts receivables, and credit risk factors.
outcome: Provides high-value management alerts on top-performing client accounts and early payment delays.
product_problem: Late dealer payments caused cash flow squeezes that were detected too late.
product_users: Credit risk officers and sales directors.
product_sol: B2B client tracking system monitoring purchase frequencies, credit timelines, and risk factors.
product_dec: Built an alert loop that flags clients when their payment lag exceeds credit terms by 7 days.
product_out: Optimized payment collection times, giving directors early warning of credit issues.
